title: 第十九章 庄家的善意第二十章 马三的挑衅
slug: 武道每日加点打更人肝成人间武圣
content_zh:
秦苏拿起筷子，先夹了一块肘子放进嘴里。
炖得软烂的肉入口即化，比武馆伙房的糙肉好上太多。
不过他没急着动第二筷，放下筷子，看向庄岳。
“庄老爷，有什么事您就直说吧。您花这么大心思请我来，我可不相信仅仅是为了谢我指点庄成”
庄岳闻言笑了笑，放下手里的茶杯，说道：“秦小兄弟快人快语，那我也就不藏着掖着了。
我是做布匹生意的，在内城勉强立足，小门小户，比不得林家。
可这安陆县，没个武者撑腰，生意根本做不久。”
他顿了顿，继续道：“请个暗劲武者当供奉，我这点家底想都不敢想。
就算是明劲武者，只有一个的话，形成不了什么威慑力。
所以我想找个有潜力的苗子，提前投资，将来他成了，能帮衬庄家一把就行。
我看来看去，整个归一武馆的新弟子里，最合我心意的，就是秦小兄弟你。”
秦苏挑了挑眉，端起茶杯抿了一口：“庄老爷怕是打错了算盘。
我是林家资助的弟子，入武馆前就签了契书，将来成了武者，首要的是给林家出力。
你投资我，最后怕是竹篮打水一场空。”
“秦小兄弟放心，我早就打听清楚了。”
庄岳摆了摆手，胸有成竹，“你和林家签的，只是入门资助契，不是死契。
林家只包了你三个月的武馆束脩，每月发三两月钱，等你们这批人里有人成了武者，才会签正式的供奉契书。
可林家会跟几个人签？依我看，除了张小乙，你们这批人，林家一个都不会留。”
秦苏没说话，等着他往下说。
“林家是安陆县的新户，家族底蕴没有那么大。”庄岳继续道。

“他们要的，是能撑场面的顶尖苗子。
张小乙是乙等根骨，百年难遇，林家砸多少资源都愿意。
可王浩、刘间，包括你秦小兄弟，就算入了明劲，上限也低，对林家来说，多一个不多，少一个不少。”
“这安陆县，明劲武者不算少，林家养一个张小乙，每月就要砸进去十几两银子，再养几个用处不大的明劲武者，浪费银子。
等三个月试炼期一过，林家随便找个由头，就会停了你们的资助。
到时候你们没了银子，练功进度只会越来越慢。”
秦苏沉默不语，庄岳说的，正是他心里一直隐隐担忧的事。
之前他五行归元桩入门的时候，从王浩和刘间里面划出银子，就足以见得。
“就算是这样，庄老爷为什么选我？”
秦苏抬眼看向庄岳，“这批人里，王浩、刘间都是丙上根骨，桩功入门也只比我晚两天，先天天赋比我好，您投资他们，不是更稳妥？”
“练武看根骨，更看心性。”
庄岳笑了，语气里满是笃定，“王浩、刘间，心浮气躁，见风使舵，见张小乙天赋好就围上去阿谀奉承，见你落了好处就心生怨恨，这点定力，成不了大器。
content_en:
Qin Su picked up the chopsticks, picked up a piece of elbow and put it into his mouth.
The stewed meat is so tender that it melts in your mouth, much better than the rough meat in the martial arts hall kitchen.
However, he was not in a hurry to use the second chopsticks. He put down his chopsticks and looked at Zhuang Yue.
"Mr. Zhuang, if you have anything to say, just tell me. I don't believe you took so much trouble to invite me here just to thank me for giving me advice to Zhuang Cheng."
Zhuang Yue smiled when he heard this, put down the tea cup in his hand, and said: "Little brother Qin is quick to talk, so I won't hide it.
I am in the cloth business and can barely establish myself in the inner city. I am a small family and cannot compare to the Lin family.
But in Anlu County, without the support of a warrior, the business would not last long. "
He paused and continued: "Asking an Anjin warrior to be a worshiper is something I wouldn't even dare to think about with my little family background.
Even if there is only one Mingjin warrior, it will not have much deterrent effect.
Therefore, I want to find a potential seedling and invest in it in advance. If it becomes successful in the future, it can help the banker.
I looked around and found that among all the new disciples in Guiyi Martial Arts Hall, the one who suits my heart the most is you, little brother Qin. "
Qin Su raised his eyebrows, picked up the tea cup and took a sip: "I'm afraid Mr. Zhuang made a wrong calculation.
I am a disciple sponsored by the Lin family. I signed a contract before entering the martial arts hall. In the future, when I become a martial artist, my first priority is to contribute to the Lin family.
If you invest in me, I'm afraid you'll end up in vain. "
"Don't worry, little brother Qin, I have already found out clearly."
Zhuang Yue waved his hand and said confidently, "What you signed with the Lin family is just an entry-level sponsorship contract, not a death contract.
The Lin family only guarantees you three months of training in the martial arts school, and pays you three or two months of money every month. The formal dedication contract will not be signed until someone in your group becomes a martial artist.
But how many people will the Lin family sign with? In my opinion, except for Zhang Xiaoyi, no one from your group will be left in the Lin family. "
Qin Su said nothing, waiting for him to continue.
"The Lin family is a new family in Anlu County, and the family background is not that big." Zhuang Yue continued.
“What they want is top talent who can hold up the scene.
Zhang Xiaoyi is a second-class person who is rare to meet in a century. The Lin family is willing to spend any amount of resources on it.
But Wang Hao, Liu Jian, including your little brother Qin, even if they join Mingjin, the upper limit is low. For the Lin family, one more is not too much, and one less is not too much. "
"There are quite a few Mingjin warriors in Anlu County. The Lin family has to spend more than ten taels of silver every month to raise a Zhang Xiaoyi, and raising a few Mingjin warriors who are of little use is a waste of money.
Once the three-month trial period is over, the Lin family will stop your funding for any reason.
When the time comes that you have no money, your practice progress will only become slower and slower. "
Qin Su was silent. What Zhuang Yue said was exactly what he had been worried about.
When he entered the Five Elements Guiyuan Zhuang before, he drew silver from Wang Hao and Liu Jian, which was enough to see.
"Even so, why did Mr. Zhuang choose me?"
Qin Su raised his eyes and looked at Zhuang Yue, "Among this group of people, Wang Hao and Liu Jian are both top-notch. They only got into Zhuang Kung Fu two days later than me. Their innate talents are better than mine. Isn't it safer for you to invest in them?"
"Martial arts training depends on one's bones, but more importantly, one's character."
Zhuang Yue smiled, his tone full of determination, "Wang Hao and Liu Jian are impetuous and act according to the wind. When they see Zhang Xiaoyi's talent, they surround you with flattery, and when they see you falling behind, they feel resentful. This kind of determination cannot achieve great results.
